title: Lint the repository's own root package in the harness gate
goal: The harness's per-task lint check names the root package the worktree's own Cargo.toml declares instead of assuming it is called susi, so a task that touches a top-level file can be built in another repository (Susi Commercial Apps' root package is susi-commercial).

reuse.searched: crates/susi-harness/src/adapter.rs (SusiTarget::gate, target_is_link), crates/susi-harness/Cargo.toml (no TOML parser among its dependencies) and docs/harness.md.
reuse.reason: A six-line reader of the root manifest inside the adapter, paid for by shortening the argument construction in the same function: the crate's source stays inside its lean ceiling (37,535 of 37,536 lines) and gains no dependency.

integration.workflow: susi harness run, native local workflow integrate

results.landing: third run: the first was refused because the local integration head was behind the published main, the second stopped on main's own red test (fixed by T-LOCALHARNESSZ0PACKZ0PATHS-1); each rerun landed the retained candidate without another worker run
results.found_by: the Susi Commercial Apps mission commercial-candidate-hint was rejected with: package ID specification susi did not match any packages
